data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'arete' meaning virtue or moral excellence. In Christian tradition, Aretina represents a holy and virtuous individual. The name Aretina carries the meaning “Virtuous, holy” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Aretina usually hope their child will grow to embody virtuous, holy and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aretina total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
